limitations: Derived from 2000 structs of 512 bytes. Pointer window 0x10000..0x7fffffffffff. The capture has NO pointee memory, so FieldInfo stride and the sub-offsets (field name ptr / field offset u32 / field type ptr) CANNOT be derived here -- they must be probed live by dereferencing the field_array_ptr candidate (+0x108) on a class with known fields.
